query: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.source_pages WHERE source_page BETWEEN 524 AND 528) AS source_pages, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.gk_facts WHERE source_page BETWEEN 524 AND 528) AS facts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.gk_notes WHERE source_page BETWEEN 524 AND 528) AS notes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.gk_mcqs WHERE source_page=525) AS mcqs, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.gk_mcq_options o JOIN public.gk_mcqs m ON m.id=o.mcq_id WHERE m.source_page=525) AS mcq_options, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.flashcards WHERE source_key LIKE 'batch0524-0528:%') AS flashcards, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.search_documents d JOIN public.gk_facts f ON d.entity_type='fact' AND d.entity_id=f.id WHERE f.source_page BETWEEN 524 AND 528) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.search_documents d JOIN public.gk_notes n ON d.entity_type='note' AND d.entity_id=n.id WHERE n.source_page BETWEEN 524 AND 528) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.search_documents d JOIN public.gk_mcqs m ON d.entity_type='mcq' AND d.entity_id=m.id WHERE m.source_page=525) AS search_documents, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.fact_verifications WHERE source_page BETWEEN 524 AND 528) AS verifications, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.content_tag_assignments WHERE assigned_by='batch-0524-0528-quality-pipeline') AS tag_assignments LIMIT 1;
